states.name: Alabama
states.coverage_note: 2004-present: the Governor's newsroom from 2017, plus November 2009 to April 2017 states of emergency from the Secretary of State's Record of Proclamations and 2004-2009 ones from dated news coverage (Ivan, Dennis, Katrina, the Enterprise tornado, Fay, Gustav, the March 2009 floods); no state declaration has been found for the May 2009 floods (DR-1842) or the January 2012 tornadoes (DR-4052), and 2000-2003 is not compared yet

states.name: Alaska
states.coverage_note: Governor administrative orders plus Governor/DHSEM disaster releases, and 2002-2025 state disaster declarations (Knowles through Dunleavy) dated from DHS&EM's Disaster Cost Index (2013 and 2018 State Hazard Mitigation Plans), DHS&EM releases and news coverage; no dated state declaration has been found for the May 2018 Susitna River flood (DR-4391) or the fall 2021 Southcentral storm (DR-4638)

states.name: Arizona
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: 2002-2022 weather emergencies from the Department of Emergency and Military Affairs annual and State Emergency Council reports, with 2014 and 2021-2022 dates from news coverage of each declaration; January 2023-present from the Governor's news releases (dated by release) and executive orders. Governor Hull's 2000-2001 weather emergencies (Mohave County windstorm, August 2000; Wenden flood and rain from Hurricane Olivia, October 2000; southwest Arizona monsoon, August 2001) are known only by month from the Auditor General's 2004 report and are not listed, and some 2014-2017 and 2021-2023 declarations named in Governor's Emergency Fund reports have no published date and are not listed

states.name: Arkansas
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: the current Governor's executive order archive from January 2023, plus earlier weather declarations added by hand from the Governor's disaster proclamations catalogued by the Arkansas State Library (2006-2011 and 2021) and dated news coverage; no declarations from 2000-2005 have been found yet, and FEMA's 2000-2004 declarations and those for February and May 2008, December 2009, May 2011 and June 2019 still have no dated state declaration

states.name: California
states.coverage_note: 2011-present: the current Governor archive from January 2019, plus the Brown administration's 2011-2018 weather states of emergency from its archived proclamations (archive.gov.ca.gov/archive/gov39), added by hand (manual_declarations.csv); declarations under Governors Davis and Schwarzenegger (2000-2010) are not added yet, so 2000-2010 is not compared

states.name: Colorado
states.coverage_note: 2000-2025 State Publications Library D-series; current Governor page blocked; 2026 backfill pending.

states.name: Connecticut
states.coverage_note: 1971-present Governor executive-order archive plus 2005-2020 DEMHS civil-preparedness declaration table. Plus 6 declarations added by hand from official announcements, order text and dated news coverage (manual_declarations.csv).

states.name: Delaware
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: the Governor's state of emergency archive from October 2025, plus earlier storm states of emergency added by hand from the Governor's news releases (news.delaware.gov) and dated news coverage, and Minner's 2002 drought order from the Delaware Public Archives; no state declaration has been found for the February 2003 snowstorm (EM-3183), the 2004 and 2006 floods (DR-1572, DR-1654) or Ida in 2021 (DR-4627), and the date of the Hurricane Isabel declaration is taken from news coverage

states.name: Florida
states.coverage_note: 2004-present: structured Governor archive from 2020, plus 28 weather emergency orders added by hand (manual_declarations.csv): Bush and Crist orders from 2004-2010 catalogued with their dates by the FSU College of Law collection on Florida Government Documents, and 2005-2019 declarations dated from the order copies kept by FMCSA, the Division of Emergency Management and DEP, archived Governor pages, and news coverage. The State Library order archive (edocs.dos.fl.gov) disallows crawlers and is not used. No state declaration was found for DR-1595 (Dennis, 2005) or DR-4138 (July 2013 flooding); EM-3259 (Rita, 2005) counts as matched only because its incident period runs into the Wilma declaration. 2000-2003 is not covered.

states.name: Georgia
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: structured Governor archives from 2011, plus 2000-2009 states of emergency added by hand from Governor Perdue's archived executive order list and, for 2000, dated FEMA and news reports of Governor Barnes's declarations; no state declaration has been found for Hurricane Zeta in October 2020 (DR-4579)

states.name: Hawaii
states.coverage_note: Current Governor emergency proclamations plus partial 2014-2022 State Procurement mirror; verified joining coverage is narrower. Plus 27 declarations added by hand from official announcements, order text and dated news coverage (manual_declarations.csv); compared from 2000, with no dated proclamation found for the November 2000 Big Island floods (DR-1348)

states.name: Idaho
states.coverage_note: 2000-present OARC EO metadata plus IDWR drought orders; non-drought proclamations have incomplete coverage.

states.name: Illinois
states.coverage_note: 2000-present numbered EO archive; disaster proclamations from 2023 on from the Governor's listing, plus 2013-2022 proclamations (Quinn, Rauner, Pritzker) from IEMA news releases and news coverage; other pre-2023 proclamations are not listed

states.name: Indiana
states.coverage_note: 2000-present via current + historical governor archives (Braun, Holcomb 2017-2025); Pence-era (2013-2017) and pre-2005 pages not yet independently re-verified

states.name: Iowa
states.coverage_note: 2020-present: HSEMD proclamation tables from 2024, plus the Governor's 2020-2023 weather disaster proclamations added by hand from the Governor's press releases (governor.iowa.gov); the newsroom starts in March 2020 and no archive of earlier proclamations has been found, so 2000-2019 is not covered yet

states.name: Kansas
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: KDEM disaster-declarations page from 2011, plus 27 declarations added by hand (manual_declarations.csv): seven 2011-2016 proclamations from scanned PDFs on that page, seven 2001-2007 declarations cited by executive orders and legislation printed in the Kansas Register, and 2006-2021 declarations dated from Adjutant General releases (archived on the Wayback Machine) and news coverage. No state declaration was found for DR-1327 (April 2000), DR-1402 (January 2002 ice storm), DR-1535 and DR-1562 (2004), DR-1579, DR-1600, DR-1615 and DR-1626 (2005), DR-1638 (March 2006), DR-1808 (September 2008), DR-1849 (April-May 2009), DR-1932 (June 2010), DR-4654 (March 2022) or DR-4747 (summer 2023).

states.name: Kentucky
states.coverage_note: manual_only - 2008-present: the Governor's newsroom releases and executive orders, plus 2008-2024 states of emergency added by hand from executive orders, official releases and dated news coverage; the Secretary of State's Executive Journal (authoritative) blocks automated requests, no dated declaration has been found for April 2008, May and August 2009, June 2011, August 2014 or Helene in 2024 (DR-1757, DR-1841, DR-1855, DR-4008, DR-4196, DR-4848), and 2000-2007 is not compared yet

states.name: Louisiana
states.coverage_note: September 2004-present: official State Register web indexes from January 2016, plus 32 weather declarations added by hand (manual_declarations.csv): 13 by Governors Blanco and Jindal (2004-2015), from proclamations cited in the Louisiana Register and dated news coverage, and 19 by Governor Edwards (2016-2023). No state declaration was found for DR-1521 (May 2004), DR-1601 (Cindy, 2005), DR-1668 (October 2006) or DR-4228 (Red River flooding, 2015); 2000 to mid-2004 (DR-1314, 1357, 1380, 1435, 1437) is not covered.

states.name: Maine
states.coverage_note: January 2003-present: 2011-present Governor executive-order archives (LePage and Mills), plus storm emergency proclamations from 2013-2024 taken from the Governor's proclamations and news releases; the adapter does not yet read the Mills proclamations listing. Plus 28 declarations added by hand from official announcements, order text and dated news coverage (manual_declarations.csv), including Governor Baldacci's 2004-2010 weather emergency proclamations from the Maine State Library's yearly archives of his press releases (2003-2010). No state declaration was found for EM-3174, EM-3190 and EM-3194 (2003 snowstorms), EM-3209, EM-3210 and DR-1591 (March 2005 snow), EM-3265 (December 2005), DR-1716 (Oxford County, July 2007: declared, but no date found), DR-1788 (July 2008) or DR-1852 (June 2009); 2000-2002 (Governor King) is not covered.

states.name: Maryland
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: the Governor's executive order archive from 2023, plus 2000-2022 weather declarations added by hand: 2000-2018 executive orders from the Department of Legislative Services' yearly compilations, and others from official announcements, order text and dated news coverage; no state declaration was found for the June 2006 flooding (DR-1652) or Tropical Storm Isaias in 2020 (DR-4583)

states.name: Massachusetts
states.coverage_note: 1970-present from the official State Library executive-order collection (orders before 1970 left off), plus 2008-2015 storm states of emergency (Patrick and Baker) from news coverage and FMCSA's copy of the 2015 declaration; other unnumbered declarations are not listed

states.name: Michigan
states.coverage_note: 2019-present structured Governor archive; 2000-2018 not covered by the current Governor source

states.name: Minnesota
states.coverage_note: 2000-present Legislative Reference Library executive order database (Ventura from 2000, Pawlenty, Dayton and Walz); weather orders that only provide assistance, without declaring an emergency, are not counted as declarations

states.name: Mississippi
states.coverage_note: January 2020-present structured Governor archive; 2008-2019 weather emergency orders read from the Secretary of State's individual order PDFs (filled in over the first few weekly runs); 2000-2010 weather emergency orders from the Secretary of State's executive order compilations (Musgrove and Barbour), most of them National Guard call-outs for storms

states.name: Missouri
states.coverage_note: 2000-present Secretary of State year indexes and legal order text.

states.name: Montana
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: dated Gianforte-era gov.mt.gov listing from 2021, plus Racicot (2000), Martz (2001-2002), Schweitzer (2006-2012) and Bullock (2013-2020) weather orders added by hand from the order texts, governor's press releases and dated news reports; four orders whose archive copies leave the signing day blank are compared with FEMA on their effective dates, and other orders with no readable signing date are still to be backfilled

states.name: Nebraska
states.coverage_note: 2000-present from the Nebraska Library Commission mirror of the full 1965-present Governor's Executive Orders index, rows kept only when a hazard or emergency keyword matched; some 2021-2026 fuel-supply orders left unclassified pending individual PDF review

states.name: Nevada
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: the current Governor's executive and emergency-order archives from January 2023, plus 2008-2021 storm, flood and wildfire declarations (Gibbons, Sandoval and Sisolak) from news coverage and FMCSA's copy of the Tamarack order; no archive of earlier declarations was found, so the July 2004 Waterfall Fire, the winter 2004-2005 storms and the December 2005 floods (DR-1540, EM-3202, EM-3204, DR-1583, DR-1629) have no state declaration

states.name: New Hampshire
states.coverage_note: 1990-present official Secretary of State registry; older non-ADA PDFs may require OCR. Weather emergencies declared without an executive order are added by hand from news coverage (NH-PROC ids).

states.name: New Jersey
states.coverage_note: 1990-present provisional structured coverage; 1962-1989 selectively represented

states.name: New Mexico
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: current-Governor index from January 2019 (many migrated document links are unavailable and are disclosed record-by-record), plus 7 weather declarations added by hand (manual_declarations.csv) by Governors Richardson (2006-2010) and Martinez (2011-2013), from executive orders reprinted in the press and dated news coverage. No state declaration was found for DR-1329 and EM-3154 (Cerro Grande Fire, May 2000), DR-1514 (April 2004 storms and flooding), DR-4047 (August 2011 flooding), DR-4079 (June 2012 flooding), DR-4197 (July 2014 storms and flooding) or DR-4199 (September 2014 storms and flooding).

states.name: New York
states.coverage_note: 2021-08-24-present comprehensive current archive; earlier official records are selected continuing orders only

states.name: North Carolina
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: the Governor's executive order archive from January 2017, plus 2000-2016 weather declarations (Hunt, Easley, Perdue and McCrory) added by hand from the State Archives of North Carolina's executive orders and Governor's press releases and dated news coverage; declarations for the February 2003 ice storm, the September 2010 floods, the late July 2013 mountain floods and the March 2014 ice storm have not been found, and some 2000-2016 orders that do not name their hazard are not listed

states.name: North Dakota
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: the Governor's executive order archive, with Dalrymple's orders read by date and title from December 2010 and numbered orders from 2017, plus the current-EOs page (dates confirmed per order against news releases); Schafer's and Hoeven's 2000-2010 orders are not on the archive, so Hoeven's March 2004 and March 2009 flood emergencies and August 2007 Northwood tornado emergency are added by hand from dated news reports and the Governor's release, and his other orders and undated 2024-2026 orders are still to be backfilled

states.name: Ohio
states.coverage_note: manual_only - Ohio's weather actions are ORC 5502.22 proclamations, not filed/numbered EOs, and no complete list is published. Proclamations from 2003 on are added by hand from the Governor's announcements and news coverage. The Governor's GovDelivery feed answers 406 to every request on record, so it adds nothing automatically.

states.name: Oklahoma
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: Oklahoma Emergency Management's emergencies-and-disasters archive from 2016 (a proxy for the robots-blocked SOS EO index), with governor declarations back to 2006 reviewed by hand from OEM event pages and the Governor's releases, and 2000-2008 disaster emergency orders added by hand from Oklahoma Administrative Code Title 1 (Executive Orders)

states.name: Oregon
states.coverage_note: 2003-present structured Governor archive; 2000-2002 unavailable in live source

states.name: Pennsylvania
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: PEMA's linked proclamation history from 2018, plus 2001-2017 storm disaster proclamations (Ridge, Rendell, Corbett and Wolf) added by hand from the Pennsylvania Bulletin, PEMA records and press coverage; no dated proclamation has been found yet for November 2006, April 2011 or summer 2013 (DR-1684, DR-4003, DR-4149), and the August 2004 storms (DR-1538) match only through the September 2004 Frances proclamation

states.name: Rhode Island
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: the Governor's executive order archive from 2015, plus 2003-2013 weather declarations (Carcieri and Chafee) from the State Archives' scanned executive orders, the Governor's press releases on ri.gov and FMCSA's copy of Executive Order 13-02; the Archives hold no executive order for the February 2003 snowstorm or the April 2007 nor'easter, and Almond's 2000-2002 orders have not been read

states.name: South Carolina
states.coverage_note: 1970-present from the official State Library collection (orders before 1970 left off), enriched from the 2017-present Governor archive

states.name: South Dakota
states.coverage_note: 2000-present SD Secretary of State executive order registry: 2020-present from its yearly tables and 2000-2019 through its prior-years search, with the hazard for each older order read from the signed copy; it lists no weather emergency declarations for 2000-2004, only waivers for hay and fuel hauling and fire-season orders

states.name: Tennessee
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: the Governor's executive orders from the Secretary of State catalog (through the University of Memphis mirror), the Governor's state of emergency proclamations from 2012, and declarations added by hand from TEMA reports, official announcements, order text and dated news coverage; most emergencies TEMA declared by activating the state emergency plan, without an order or proclamation, have no dated record yet

states.name: Texas
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: current-Governor proclamation archive from January 2015, plus 36 weather declarations added by hand (manual_declarations.csv): 2001-2014 proclamations from archived copies of the Governor's proclamation pages (governor.state.tx.us, via the Wayback Machine) and 2000, 2001, 2015 and 2025 declarations from dated news and TDEM coverage. No state declaration was found for DR-1356 (December 2000 ice storm), DR-1425 (2002 floods), DR-1479 (Claudette, 2003), DR-1658 (El Paso flooding, 2006), DR-1709 (June 2007 floods), DR-1730 and EM-3277 (Erin and Dean, 2007); DR-1999 and DR-4029 (2011 wildfires) fell under the December 2010 wildfire proclamation, which was renewed month by month and is not counted as a new declaration.

states.name: Utah
states.coverage_note: 2000-present Office of Administrative Rules executive-document indexes and legal texts.

states.name: Vermont
states.coverage_note: 2017-present structured Governor archive, plus 2011-2015 emergency orders from the Vermont Statutes appendix (3 V.S.A. App. ch. 20); orders from 2000-2010 were rescinded in 2015 and dropped from the current appendix, but the four still in force in 2011 (July 2000 and June 2002 floods, the April 2007 nor'easter, the December 2008 ice storm) are kept from the 2011-2014 editions. Plus 5 declarations added by hand from official announcements, order text and dated news coverage (manual_declarations.csv).

states.name: Virginia
states.coverage_note: Virginia structured archive coverage begins in 2002, plus Gilmore's 2000-2001 weather emergency orders added by hand from the Virginia Register of Regulations; the current administration is collected separately

states.name: Washington
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: structured Governor proclamation archive from 2013, with 2000-2012 weather proclamations (Locke and Gregoire) added by hand from the Washington State Digital Archives and the termination proclamations that list them; Gregoire proclamations 09-06, 09-07 and 10-08 could not be read, and 07-01 is dated from the termination that lists it

states.name: West Virginia
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: the Governor's news archive from 2025, plus 2001-2024 weather declarations added by hand from the Governor's state of emergency proclamations in the Secretary of State's Executive Journal (and Executive Order 14-01 for the July 2001 flooding); the Journal holds no proclamations from Governor Underwood, so DR-1319 (February 2000) has no state declaration

states.name: Wisconsin
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: the current Governor archive from January 2019, plus the 2000-2018 weather states of emergency (Governors Thompson, McCallum, Doyle and Walker) read from the Legislature's executive order archive (docs.legis.wisconsin.gov), as listed under States of Emergency in the Legislative Reference Bureau's Index to Executive Orders, added by hand (manual_declarations.csv); early PDFs may require OCR

states.name: Wyoming
states.coverage_note: 2000-present: the Governor CMS executive-order archive from 2019, plus declarations added by hand from official announcements, order text and dated news coverage (manual_declarations.csv): Governor Freudenthal's June 2010 Fremont County flood disaster declaration and Governor Mead's flood declarations (2011, 2015, February 2017). No archive of earlier Wyoming governors' orders exists, and no state declaration has been found for the November 2000 winter storm (DR-1351), the August 2005 Wright tornado (DR-1599), the June 2017 floods (DR-4327) or the June 2023 Casper flood (DR-4739)
